programme.desc: In 1812, young British aristocrat Edmund Talbot travels by ship to Australia and learns more about himself and about life than he had ever bargained for.

programme.title: A Deadly Encounter
programme.desc: Thriller. After working late one night, restaurant hostess Joanne Sanders (Laura Leighton, ʻMelrose Placeʼ) accidentally cuts up a car on the highway, which leads the other driver (Alain Goulem, ʻ18 to Lifeʼ) to stalk and harass her, determined to exact his revenge.

programme.title: Mystery Woman 6: Redemption
programme.desc: A rare first edition from a pioneer author goes missing in the mystery novels-specialized Kinsey bookshop during remodeling by the local firm of Tyler Dell, who recently lost his father, a Vietnam veteran. Retired English teacher Jim Carter, who overheard everything, is murdered shortly after a row in Reverend Tucker's homeless shelter Haven with aggressive lush Murphy. Rude police chief Connors isn't up to an investigation while the killer keeps sniping, so the bookstore's armchair sleuths duo does it alone, starting from a lacquered box left by Jim for his illegitimate daughter, who never even knew his name. It starts a set of cues, slowly unraveling a grim intrigue starting during a 1965 US illegal intrusion into Red Khmer territory.

programme.title: Mystery Woman 10: In the Shadows
programme.desc: While searching for a KGB double agent who was about to be exposed by another Russian spy-turned-successful author, mystery bookstore owner Samantha Kinsey and her secretive friend and store manager, Philby are thrust into the murderous world of international espionage.

programme.title: Ambulance Girl
programme.desc: Comedy drama directed by and starring Kathy Bates. When paralysing phobias threaten the personal and professional life of a food writer (Bates), she decides to venture off in a completely different direction. As a volunteer paramedic, she finally discovers the perfect way to help herself by helping others.

programme.title: Audrey's Rain
programme.desc: Heart-warming drama about a bitter, sharp-tongued spinster, whose future looks bleakwhen she is saddled with raising her nephew and niece after her sister commits suicide. Audrey resents that her family has robbed her of a life of her own, but when her childhood sweetheart reappears on the scene, her life takes an unexpected turn.

programme.title: DC 9/11: Time of Crisis
programme.desc: Gideon Banks lost his wife Liz and son Simon in a horrific car accident some twenty years ago. At the time of the accident he was involved in something called the Neural Archiving Project - NAP for short. The technology was developed to create smart computers - transferring human engrams to computers. The company eventually gave up on the technology, but Gideon didn't. After years of quietly perfecting it, he built a small robot, from parts he stole from Concorde Robotics, where he now works. Zoe, Gideon's niece, discovers Gideon's secret, the robot contains actual neural engrams from the real Simon. She becomes worried not only about Gideon but also about the robot that sounds and acts a lot like her little cousin used to.

programme.title: The Pledge/A Gunfighter's Pledge
programme.desc: Ex-lawman Matt Austin (Luke Perry) accidentally kills an innocent man (Alex Paez) while hunting an outlaw who killed his family. He pledges to the dying man that he will take his body to his sister Amaya (Jaclyn DeSantis). Austin wrestles with the idea of telling her he caused the death, but is faced with bigger battles once at the farm. There he gets involved with land baron Horn (C. Thomas Howell), who is trying to take Amaya's land. Their lives are more intertwined than he thought, when he takes on Horn and discovers that Horn has hired the man he was looking for all along.

programme.title: An Unexpected Love
programme.desc: An unhappily married housewife and mother of two children (Leslie Hope) seperates from her husband and gets a new job where she developes a mutual attraction to her female boss (Wendy Crewson).

programme.title: Word of Honor
programme.desc: A corporate exec and family man is accused of participating in a war crime 30 years earlier during the Vietnam War.

programme.title: Category 7: The End of the World
programme.desc: With extreme weather and deadly storms threatening to destroy major population centres around the US, head of FEMA, Judith Carr, battles to mitigate the damage and provide relief. Aided by her former college lover, Dr. Ross Duffy, and her father, Senator Ryan Carr, Judith investigates what is casuing the storms and tries to navigate the murky political waters. At the same time, two fake Christian fundamentalists use the disasters to justify stealing first-born children.

programme.title: Category 7: The End of the World
programme.desc: The warming effect is creating new regions of extreme weather, but something else is triggering it; something that when combined with record-breaking heat waves creates explosions in the sky. With time running out, discredited scientist Faith Clavell, teams up with storm chaser Tornado Tommy (Emmy nominee Randy Quaid, "Elvis") and Judith to discover the trigger.

programme.title: Out of the Ashes
programme.desc: A Holocaust survivor heads for America where she dreams of starting a new life, but finds it difficult to put the past behind her, especially when she's forced to relive the nightmare of Auschwitz.

programme.title: Deadly Isolation
programme.desc: Crafty Patrick Carlson and his violent accomplice Kyle Mumford have hidden in the woods up north for months after pulling off a major diamonds robbery in San Fracisco. They hoped to collect the loot from a third accomplice, who says it must be with Susan, the widow of professor Ron Mandaway, who probably hid it before committing suicide. Patrick adopts the false identity of Jeff Watkins, a retired entrepreneur, who supposedly had a yachting accident, so she'll take him into her luxury island villa. Jeff's charms win her confidence, but can't find the diamonds, and she seems unaware. Kyle loses his patience, and local sheriff Kirby Grantham, who regularly pays Susan a friendly visit, becomes a problem when his deputy finds Jeff's identity most suspicious.

programme.title: End of Days
programme.desc: Bodyguard Jericho Cane stumbles across a demonic state of affairs when he prevents the assassination of his Wall Street employer. It transpires that Cane's boss is Satan himself, come to impregnate a woman on the eve of the new millennium and so bring about the end of days foretold in the Book of Revelation. With the help of his partner, Chicago, Cane now attempts to protect Christine from both Satan and a group of priests who believe that her death is the only way to halt Armageddon.

programme.title: Monte Walsh
programme.desc: Montelius "Monte" Walsh (Tom Selleck) is an aging cowboy facing the final days of the Wild West era. He and his friend Chet Rollins (Keith Carradine), another long-time cowhand, work at whatever ranch work comes their way, but "nothing they can't do from a horse". Their lives are divided between months on the range and the occasional trip into town. Camaraderie and competition with the other cowboys fill their days. They seek work and take a job at the ranch of Cal Brennan (William Devane), where they meet an old friend, Shorty Austin (George Eads), another ranch hand.

programme.title: Murder Among Friends
programme.desc: Isabella Delarocca is a young Italian who moves to Hollywood determined to succeed as an actress. Isabella begins to teach theater classes and when a colleague of hers is arrested for murder, she decides to investigate on her behalf because she does not believe that he is guilty.

programme.title: For Love Alone: The Ivana Trump Story
programme.desc: The triumphs and tragedies of Katrinka Kovár, a young Czechoslovakian ski prodigy who discovers high-society splendor in the arms of a wealthy American businessman. When lust turns to lies, Katrinka--long haunted by a burning secret from her past--sets out to find the love she left behind.

programme.title: Love is a Four Letter Word
programme.desc: Margaret and Martin Harper, both sixty years old, are filing for divorce, but plan to keep everything as civilized as possible. Complications arise when their respective attorneys, the equally cynical Emily Bennett and Kenton Rhodes, unexpectedly fall in love, throwing an extra kink into the proceedings both in and out of the courtroom.

programme.title: Redeemer
programme.desc: A writer is touched by the story of a former Black Panther who seams to have been wrongfully convicted to life imprisonment 20 years ago. The writer decides to try to help the now middle-aged convict get exonerated.

programme.title: The Five People You Meet In Heaven
programme.desc: Social. American social drama, produced in 2004. An accident sends Eddie in Heaven! While there, he meets five people who explain to him what the key moments in his life were, through which the real meaning of his life is recorded.

programme.title: The Five People You Meet In Heaven
programme.desc: Social. American social drama, produced in 2004. An accident sends Eddie in Heaven! While there, he meets five people who explain to him what the key moments in his life were, through which the real meaning of his life is recorded.

programme.title: Desolation Canyon
programme.desc: Western about a sheriff ('Dallas' star, Patrick Duffy) who persuades his old friend (Stacy Keach, 'Prison Break'), a retired gunslinger, to join himin pursuit of a notorious gang. The band of outlaws counts the gunslinger's son as one of its members.

programme.title: The Reading Room
programme.desc: Fulfilling his beloved wife's dying wish, William Campbell restores an abandoned building they own into a reading room for a depressed community notorious for its ineffectual high school and street gangs.

programme.title: Lone Rider
programme.desc: Bobby Hattaway (Lou Diamond Phillips), an honored soldier, returns home after the American Civil War to find his father's (Stacy Keach) formerly prosperous store now dangerously in debt to the town's ruthless leader, and Bobby's childhood friend, Stu Croker (Vincent Spano). Bobby will now face off against his former friend to take control from Stu.

programme.title: New Worlds
programme.desc: 1680: Young Ned Hawkins comes to Hadley, Massachusetts, to collect rents from the settlers on behalf of his father, the landlord. When native Americans attack Ned fights them off along with Pastor Russell and his daughter Hope in a party led by William Goffe, a fugitive regicide wanted by Charles II for his part in his father's execution. Goffe makes it clear to Ned that he sees his father as a greedy land grabber. In England republican Angelica Fanshawe falls foul of tyrannical clay pit owner Hardwick and his kinsman Judge Jeffreys, who forces Will Blood to spy on Angelica's 'nest of vipers' in return for his father's life. Now married to Roman Catholic John Francis Angelica is about to celebrate her daughter Beth's birthday when outlaws led by Goffe's son Abe arrive, robbing the guests, who include the Duke of Monmouth, Charles' illegitimate son who is hoping to mount a rebellion. Abe rides off with Beth and tells her that her true father was Edward Sexby, a man who gave his life fighting injustice. Back in Hadley Edward Randolph, the king's agent, tracks down Goffe, who commits suicide rather than be arrested. As Pastor Russell is taken to be tried for harbouring a regicide he asks Ned to warn Angelica that she is in danger.

programme.title: New Worlds
programme.desc: John Hawkins sends Ned back to England to avoid his being accused of helping a regicide whilst pastor Russell dies in prison and John insists that Hope marry widower Henry Cresswell so she will not be alone. In Oxfordshire Beth and Abe blow up the clay-pits where Hardwick has been using slaves as his work force and go on the run as highway robbers. They meet Ned, who is on his way to warn Angelica that her letters to Goffe have been intercepted. As a result Jeffreys, who is trying to provoke John Francis into denying the Popish Plot to kill the king, has his evidence and arrests John. Abe tells Ned that he is Goffe's son and soon afterwards attempts to kill king Charles but is himself wounded and nursed by Angelica. The boys escape but Beth and her mother are also arrested and charged with assisting a regicide. Angelica agrees to plead guilty if Beth is exiled to the Americas, rather than face execution. King Charles now seems to have eradicated all opposition and dissolves his parliament, giving himself total autocracy.

programme.title: Fear the Walking Dead
programme.desc: Teddy (John Glover) brought about his vision of "The End" when he detonated nuclear warheads across the Texas landscape, but it will be up to those who survived to decide what "The Beginning" will look like. And they'll have to do it in a world devoid of light and hope, where the outside air is just as deadly as the walkers they face. The survivors will find out who they really are and what they're really made of. Some will rise to the occasion, some will find new purpose, and some will redefine themselves -- even if it comes at a terrible cost to those they once considered family.

programme.title: To The Ends of The Earth
programme.desc: In 1812, young British aristocrat Edmund Talbot travels by ship to Australia and learns more about himself and about life than he had ever bargained for.

programme.title: Mystery Woman 5: Game Time
programme.desc: Bright youngest graduate Randy (Stinky) Lawrence convinces Samantha to promote his brilliant murder video game in the bookstore in exchange for his help in convincing "old friend" Donald Fiske, a celebrated author, to do a signing session there. To Randy's surprise, it works, but Fiske is poisoned after slipping out angry. Randy is Chief Connors's only suspect. Despite obvious repeated lies, Samantha sets out to prove his innocence. Fiske's greedy ex, Jody, pretends to have convinced him to remarry, yet she never even allowed their teenage son Cameron to set foot in Donald's fine home.

programme.title: Mystery Woman 7: At First Sight
programme.desc: After dating hot doctor Ben, "Mystery Woman" Samantha becomes curious about her family medical history so she sets out upstate to fictitious small town; Whiptail, California in search of her birth mother. Samantha finds her unfortunately she has just been arrested as a suspect in a murder. Murder and mystery follow Samantha wherever she goes.

programme.title: Mystery Woman 8: Wild West Mystery
programme.desc: Former Red River TV series star Clint Lawson's Wild West show is in town, the prize act in the annual festival, which the sponsoring bookshop is presiding over. He strains a leg due to a sabotaged saddle strap. His stand-in, Dogie, is fatally shot while starring in his place, so who was the intended target? Evidence seems to pile up against Clint, so the chief simply jails him without further investigation. However, the bookshop sleuths team digs up dirty secrets from their past and that of other show cast, such as ex-con announcer Jeb Fletcher, Clint's ex-lover Annie whom he promised a movie part like Strother Elam, and Zeke Foster, who secretly deals in illegitimate Red River memorabilia.

programme.title: Mystery Woman 9: Oh Baby
programme.desc: Murder mystery. A couple implicated in a murder go on the run, leaving their baby in the care of amateur sleuth Samantha Kinsey. Can she look after the baby and solve the case? Kellie MartinCasey SanderNina Siemazsko Vicki Davis.

programme.title: Acceptance
programme.desc: Paul confesses his feelings to Rosanna. He gets Rosanna to admit to her feelings for him but she insists she cant think about anything but Cabots welfare for now. She agrees to leave the door open between them. Meanwhile, Barbara goes to James to let him know that his plan for Jordan and Rosanna is falling apart. She indirectly asks James for his help in making sure Jordan and Rosanna stay together. Soon after, Cabot mysteriously appears in the middle of Fairwinds, when neither Paul nor Rosanna put him there! A new clue appears in the paper and Chris, Alison, Emily and Susan are all trying to figure it out. When Nancy cant help, Alison goes to Aaron. He agrees to help her, and Alison doesnt tell him about her engagement. Meanwhile, Bob helps Chris with the clue. Chris hurries to the dance studio where the key is apparently hidden and finds a tango lesson underway. Emily and Chris agree to take a tango lesson in order to get to the key. They are dancing together when Alison and Aaron arrive outside. Alison is about to go in when Aaron notices her ring. Tom confronts Margo about the compact and she tells him its not hers. Tom asks her one more time if it was only a kiss between her and Doc. Margo confirms the lie and they agree to try to move on. Jill has overheard everything. She confronts Margo after Tom leaves, promising to keep quiet about what she has witnessed on one condition. Meanwhile, Ben tells Jessica hell agree to in Vitro. At the hospital, Jessica bumps into Doc and admits shes been too hard on him. Then Dr. Schilling informs her she isnt a candidate for in vitro because shes already pregnant! Doc looks on as Ben hugs Jessica to celebrate the good news.

programme.title: Monte Walsh
programme.desc: Montelius "Monte" Walsh (Tom Selleck) is an aging cowboy facing the final days of the Wild West era. He and his friend Chet Rollins (Keith Carradine), another long-time cowhand, work at whatever ranch work comes their way, but "nothing they can't do from a horse". Their lives are divided between months on the range and the occasional trip into town. Camaraderie and competition with the other cowboys fill their days. They seek work and take a job at the ranch of Cal Brennan (William Devane), where they meet an old friend, Shorty Austin (George Eads), another ranch hand.

programme.title: Sacricfies of the Heart
programme.desc: Emotional family drama. A hotshot city lawyer (Melissa Gilbert, ʻLittle House on the Prairieʼ) returns to the family farm run by her older brother and her estranged father, who is suffering from Alzheimerʼs disease. As his health and memory deteriorate, she reaches a new understanding about what drove her mother to commit suicide.

programme.desc: An unhappily married housewife and mother of two children (Leslie Hope) seperates from her husband and gets a new job where she developes a mutual attraction to her female boss (Wendy Crewson).

programme.title: I Do (But I Don't)

programme.title: The Long Shot
programme.desc: Drama. A woman moves with her seven-year-old daughter and husband to California from Colorado. After her husband abandons them, she tries to rebuild their lives. Finding solace caring for horses, she decides to enter a horse show.

programme.title: New Worlds
programme.desc: King Charles gives Hardwick Angelica's land for new clay-pits but denies him the house until he has captured Abe. Aware that Angelica's faithful servants will be condemned to work in the clay-pits Abe goes to London to seek out his father's old friend Colonel Sidney and they plot to assassinate the king but they are caught and imprisoned. Beth's ship is wrecked on the shore at Massachusetts and she is adopted by the Wawanaki tribe, led by Masca, with whom she mutually falls in love and goes native. In Boston Hope marries Cresswell to the dismay of Ned, who has returned to the New World. He begins an affair with her but are discovered by Cresswell who forbids them to meet on pain of death. In order to clear the natives off their land Cresswell , acting in collusion with Kohn Hawkins, makes a present of blankets to the Wawanaki but they are deliberately infected with small-pox. Lacking any immunity many of the tribe, including Masca, die. Realizing that Cresswell has deliberately murdered them she stabs him in the presence of Ned.

programme.title: New Worlds
programme.desc: With Cresswell dead Hope and Ned are free to marry. They are, however, suspicious of John Hawkins' part in distributing the infected blankets and argue with him. As a result he has a heart attack and dies, asking Ned to take over his business though Ned is more concerned with helping Beth to hide Hope. Abe is visited in Oxford jail but Angelica's maid Agnes, who gives him a potion which simulates death and his 'corpse' is thrown into the plague pit, from where Agnes and her grandfather Adam rescue him. However Colonel Sidney is executed but Ned manages to obtain the colonel's writings, advocating freedom from Britain for the colonies, which he has smuggled into Boston. He and Hope are organizing a meeting for like-minded young colonists but they are interrupted by armed troopers who shoot and kill them. Beth returns to England to see the insurgents who took part in Monmouth's unsuccessful rebellion, being put to death. These include Agnes and Adam but she is reunited with Abe who has managed to escape.

And they'll have to do it in a world devoid of light and hope, where the outside air is just as deadly as the walkers they face. The survivors will find out who they really are and what they're really made of. Some will rise to the occasion, some will find new purpose, and some will redefine themselves -- even if it comes at a terrible cost to those they once considered family.

programme.title: Wyvern
programme.desc: The small Alaskan town of Beaver Mills is located just north of the Arctic Circle, meaning that the sun does not set during the summer solstice. As the town prepares for its annual celebration of this event, a wyvern is awakened by the melting of the ice caps, and attacks a fisherman. Jake (Nick Chinlund), a handyman fixing the cafe where a waitress named Claire (Erin Karpluk) works, hurts his hand and David (David Lewis (Canadian actor)), the town's doctor, examines it. While driving back to town, David is attacked by the wyvern. The next morning, Sheriff Dawson (John Shaw) and Jake hear gunshots and find Haas (Barry Corbin), a redneck attacked by the wyvern. Colonel (Don S. Davis), who has seen the Wyvern, goes to town to warn the citizens; but they disbelieve him, and he goes to kill it. Dawson radios to his Deputy Susie (Elaine Miles) to watch the town, but fails to convey his meaning. Dawson finds his friend dead, and returns. At the town, the wyvern kills Susie and several other people. Jake, Claire, Haas, and the eccentric Edna (Karen Austin) take shelter in the cafe. Later, Vinyl (Tinsel Korey), who runs the town's radio, and Farley (Simon Longmore), another citizen, hide in the cafe. Sheriff Dawson is killed by the wyvern. Jake and Claire track the wyvern into the woods, where they find the Colonel, and discover the wyvern is killing anyone on the Interstate. Farley is injured trying to get supplies. The wyvern then uses David, still alive, as bait to draw people from the cafe. Jake goes to rescue him, and Farley distracts the wyvern to save them, but is eaten. David tells the group the Wyvern has eggs, and dies of his injuries. The survivors decide to electrify the nest, but the wyvern kills Haas. Jake takes a truck left on the side of the road and, using the eggs as bait, kills the wyvern. Jake, Claire, Colonel, Vinyl, and Edna try again to radio for help.

Patrick adopts the false identity of Jeff Watkins, a retired entrepreneur, who supposedly had a yachting accident, so she'll take him into her luxury island villa. Jeff's charms win her confidence, but can't find the diamonds, and she seems unaware. Kyle loses his patience, and local sheriff Kirby Grantham, who regularly pays Susan a friendly visit, becomes a problem when his deputy finds Jeff's identity most suspicious.

programme.title: Eurolygos rungtynės. Play-In. Panathinaikos - AS Monaco
programme.desc: The EuroLeague is the top-tier European professional basketball club competition since 2000. The competition replaced the FIBA EuroLeague (which was previously called the FIBA European Champions Cup, or simply the European Cup), which had been run by FIBA since 1958. Starting from 2010/2011 season the tournament is named Turkish Airlines Euroleague, due to a sponsorship contract of Turkish Airlines with EuroLeague, and in 2013 the contract was prolonged to 2020. The tournament is aired in 199 countries of the world. The current EuroLeague structure is made up of 16 teams, which each play each other twice, once at home and once away, in a double round robin league regular season, each team plays 30 games. The top 8 placed teams at the end of the regular season advance to playoffs, each plays a 5 game playoff series against a single opponent. The winners of each playoff series advance to the Final Four held in a predetermined city for two days. The Final Four features two semifinals, a third place game, and the championship game, all on the same weekend.

programme.title: National Parks: USA
programme.desc: Along Washington State's rugged coast, Olympic National Park protects 1 million acres of diverse habitat. Coastal fog hits glacier-capped mountains, drenching the land in record rainfall and giving rise to temperate rainforests. This unique landscape hosts a rich biodiversity, including the endemic Olympic Marmot, Roosevelt elk, bobcats and one of the last Pacific salmon runs in the lower 48.

programme.title: National Parks: USA
programme.desc: As the first national park founded to protect wildlife and ecological richness, the Everglades teems with life above and below water. This land of diversity boasts nine unique ecosystems, each shaped by the wet and dry seasons ebb and flow. Roseate spoonbills, black bears, alligators, bottlenose dolphins and panthers all thrive in the largest subtropical wilderness in North America.

programme.title: National Parks: USA
programme.desc: Zion's iconic landscapes feature soaring red spires against a clear blue sky. Beyond canyons and cliffs, water emerges as a surprising force. The humble Virgin River, sculpting a geologic masterpiece over millennia, sustains diverse life in Zion National Park. Climbers, bighorn sheep, wild turkeys, and globe mallow bees all find refuge alongside this flowing lifeline.

programme.title: Built to Survive
programme.desc: Phil Breslin, third generation Indigenous educator, biologist and adventurer is on a quest to reveal some of the strangest and most specialised animal adaptations on the planet. Focusing on Australia's incredibly varied landscapes and environments, Phil yarns with First Nations people about habitats, traverses deserts, dives in the ocean's depths and uses science to identify Australia's ultimate animal survivors.

programme.title: Built to Survive
programme.desc: Phil Breslin, third generation Indigenous educator, biologist and adventurer is on a quest to reveal some of the strangest and most specialised animal adaptations on the planet. Focusing on Australia's incredibly varied landscapes and environments, Phil yarns with First Nations people about habitats, traverses deserts, dives in the ocean's depths and uses science to identify Australia's ultimate animal survivors.

programme.title: Katavi - Africa's Fallen Paradise
programme.desc: Katavi National Park spans over 3,000 square miles of western Tanzania. Lions, hippos and crocodiles live in harmony, until an unusual climatic cycle turns the normal dry season into an extreme drought. Lion cubs face mortal danger from a rogue male lion intent on a takeover, hippos fight viciously for dwindling river territory, and even the crocodiles struggle to survive until the rains arrive.

programme.title: Croatia's Coast
programme.desc: More than a mere holiday destination, the islands, mountains and forests of the Croatian coast reveal a world of unexpected wildlife and hidden natural treasures. Majestic raptors ride the winds while cicadas sing; geckos defy gravity and the blenny tidal pool-hops. In the mountains, the chamois, lynx and brown bears roam the Velebit range against the backdrop of the breathtaking Adriatic Sea.

programme.title: Ocean with David Attenborough
programme.desc: David Attenborough draws on a lifetime of experience to reveal Earth's most spectacular underwater habitats, showing that we're in the greatest age of Ocean discovery and highlighting its vital importance. While exposing the Ocean's biggest challenges, Attenborough's message is one of hope: the opportunity for marine life recovery on an unprecedented scale is within reach.

programme.title: Katavi - Africa's Fallen Paradise
programme.desc: Katavi is in the grips of extraordinary drought. A new litter of lion cubs is born into tough conditions, vulnerable to the attack of a rogue male, intent on taking over the pride. Water levels drop by the day, pushing two hippos to overthrow an alpha bull. Distant storms bring not rain but fire sparked by lightning. In the crushing heat, life desperately struggles to hold out for rain.

programme.title: Katavi - Africa's Fallen Paradise
programme.desc: Katavi's wetlands are unrecognizable in a prolonged drought, reduced to fetid, overcrowded mud wallows. At last, rains resurrect the river, inch by inch. Tensions wash away as hippos and crocodiles rejoice in the return of deep water … but flooding traps lion cubs in a precarious position. Normality will finally return to Katavi, but amidst global climate change, for how long?

programme.title: Croatia's Coast

programme.title: Hunters of the Reef
programme.desc: Tropical coral reefs are the picture of colorful, light-dappled tranquility - but that's a scuba diver's perspective. To the scaly and gilled inhabitants, it's a fish-eat-fish environment ruled by pods of dolphins who prowl the area at mealtimes while everyone else runs for cover. Incredible weapons, camouflage, venomous defenses and exceptional strategies have evolved among the smaller hunters in constant competition. Lionfish hunt in packs, injecting any objectors with venom from their frilly spikes. The mantis shrimp has polarized vision and the fastest jab on the planet. Cuttlefish morph their skin to match the sand, then attack with tentacle harpoons. The hunt is on in the shifting tides!

programme.title: Ocean with David Attenborough

While exposing the Ocean's biggest challenges, Attenborough's message is one of hope: the opportunity for marine life recovery on an unprecedented scale is within reach.

programme.title: New Wave Warriors
programme.desc: When we hear all the bad news about how climate change, pollution and overfishing are destroying marine habitats, it's not hard to get thoroughly depressed. Is there hope amidst the gloom and doom? This is the story of the innovators and image-makers, the adventurers and organizers who don't always make headlines but are doing their part to protect the oceans. These intrepid conservationists are pulling off amazing feats, despite the odds, the gloom, and the daunting, sometimes thankless task of swimming against the tide.

programme.title: The Last Rhinos: A New Hope
programme.desc: Photographer Ami Vitale follows an audacious global effort to save the Northern White Rhino from extinction. With only two surviving females, a team of scientists must race to create the world's first ever surrogate rhino pregnancy. The fate of this iconic species now rests in the hands of the keepers, rangers, and scientists devoted to beating the odds and saving the species before it's too late.

programme.title: Ghost Elephants
programme.desc: Legend says there are "ghost elephants" hidden in the highlands of Angola that have never been seen by humans. Acclaimed director Werner Herzog ("Grizzly Man") follows an epic quest to the Angolan highlands led by National Geographic Explorer and conservation biologist Dr. Steve Boyes to find these majestic and elusive creatures.

programme.title: Nilgiris - A Shared Wilderness
programme.desc: For over two and a half billion years, the forces of nature have intricately shaped the Nilgiri Mountains into the magical place it is today, helping to make it India's first UNESCO Biosphere Reserve. Embark on a journey to discover these "blue mountains," a land that has challenged conventional notions of wilderness and showcased nature's remarkable ability to adapt and thrive amidst human presence. Here lives a story of hope, fragility and interconnected futures, where humans and wildlife live within the blurred boundaries of a shared wilderness.

programme.title: Secrets of the Bees
programme.desc: National Geographic Explorer Bertie Gregory explores the extraordinary lives of bees — among the planet's most important animals. Over three years, special cameras opened a rare window into a single hive, revealing their hidden world. But with more than 20,000 bee species pollinating one-third of the world's food, this series uncovers their astonishing architecture and intelligence, unlocking their secrets.

programme.title: Secrets of the Bees
programme.desc: National Geographic Explorer Bertie Gregory returns to the honeybee sisterhood as they race to rebuild before winter. Across the planet, other bees face challenges of their own — from Dawson's bees battling for mates to honeybees facing the global spread of varroa mites. With Explorer Dr. Sammy Ramsey, Bertie explores the mounting pressures on bees and bold solutions to secure their future.

programme.title: The Incredible Dr. Pol
programme.desc: With more than 19,000 patients, Dr. Pol has seen it all. Specializing in large farm animals, this senior is anything but retiring as he takes an old-school, non-nonsense approach to veterinary medicine. Unflappable and unstoppable, this doc routinely puts in 14-hour days and is a legend in his community. This new series travels with him across rural Michigan to care for every family pet and head of livestock in need of his expertise and kindness.

programme.title: Chimp School
programme.desc: In Sierra Leone chimps are struggling. After civil war and Ebola, they are not a priority. The race is on to bring them back from the brink. Tacugama Chimp Sanctuary is doing that. For the chimps the mission is simple; find your personality, find your place in a troop, and find a way to live. This is an intimate, harrowing and heart-warming story told through the evolving and enchanting lives of individual chimp characters fighting to survive.

programme.title: Mystery Gorilla
programme.desc: In the forest of northern Congo, more than 100,000 western lowland gorillas have largely managed to avoid human contact. What they've been hiding is astounding. From tool use to intricate social behavior, these gorillas lead complex lives. Explorer and primatologist, Mireya Mayor, journeys deep into the unforgiving jungle to uncover the secrets of these mysterious giants.

programme.title: Cat Attack-Tics
programme.desc: Explore the many ways wild cats go in for the kill. Cats rarely seen in action, such as the marbled cat, the fishing cat and the sand cat, will all be featured in Cat Attack-tics. Classic Nat Geo footage is mixed with high-tech graphics, freeze frames and photo finishes to magnify the killer weaponry.

programme.title: Serengeti Speed Queen
programme.desc: Nzuri is the Speed Queen of the Serengeti - but being fast isn't enough. She's constantly bullied by hyenas on the grassland and hunted by lions in the marsh. When two of her cubs are killed, the family is exiled to the transition forest. There, she learns to adapt her hunting methods and adds strategy to speed in order to outwit her enemies and steer her remaining cubs successfully to adulthood.

programme.title: Cat Wars: Lion vs Cheetah
programme.desc: Caught on tape in Africa's wild Serengeti is a stunning act of violence between two top predators. Three cheetahs are brutally attacked by two male lions - the first time an attack like this has ever been filmed. Now, filmmaker Leo Kuenkel, who witnessed the attack, is trying to make sense of it. Was this a once-in-a-lifetime "perfect storm" event? Or do these iconic African cats have a deep-set, sinister reason to fight to the death?

programme.title: Croc Wars: Grumeti Vs Mara
programme.desc: Each year, nearly two million wildebeest and zebra cross the Serengeti on a quest for fresh grazing. But two legendary rivers stand in their way—the Grumeti and the Mara—each ruled by a formidable dynasty of Nile crocodiles. In "Croc Wars," follow these ancient predators as they prepare for the feast of the year, but not all crocodiles are created equal. In the deep, fast waters of the Mara, privilege reigns, kills come easy, and food is plentiful. In the rugged Grumeti, crocodiles must outwit, adapt and fight for every scrap. From brutal ambushes to stolen kills, this is a high-stakes battle for survival on two rivers with two strategies and only one chance to eat.

programme.title: Cave Crocs of Gabon
programme.desc: A caving expedition recently discovered a community of dwarf crocodiles living in the Abanda Caves, Gabon. The crocs are living in pitch darkness, hunt bats and some have bright-orange skin. Part of the original team returns to find out more about this bizarre phenomenon. It's mission impossible to access the crocs world and there's no way of knowing what they might find.

programme.title: Cougar vs. Wolf

His goal: pinpoint the places where cougar-wolf conflicts most often occur by gathering clues about each creatures hunting, feeding and fighting behaviors.

programme.title: Chimp School
programme.desc: In Sierra Leone chimps are struggling. After civil war and Ebola, they are not a priority. The race is on to bring them back from the brink. Tacugama Chimp Sanctuary is doing that. For the chimps the mission is simple; find your personality, find your place in a troop, and find a way to live. This is an intimate, harrowing and heart-warming story told through the evolving and enchanting lives of individual chimp characters fighting to survive.

programme.title: Primate Planet
programme.desc: National Geographic Wild. From tropical treetops to snowy peaks, Primate Planet takes you on a whirlwind tour of the wild world of primates, uncovering their unique behaviors, strong family bonds, and surprising personalities.

programme.title: Mystery Gorilla
programme.desc: In the forest of northern Congo, more than 100,000 western lowland gorillas have largely managed to avoid human contact. What they've been hiding is astounding. From tool use to intricate social behavior, these gorillas lead complex lives. Explorer and primatologist, Mireya Mayor, journeys deep into the unforgiving jungle to uncover the secrets of these mysterious giants.

programme.title: Jaguar: Jungle Icon of Guyana

programme.title: The Incredible Pol Farm
programme.desc: The long-awaited spinoff of the legendary The Incredible Dr. Pol franchise has finally hatched! Spearheaded by Dr. Pol and his son Charles, the Pol familys three generations are all joining forces to grow their animal loving empire and take on an ambitious new project: transforming 350-acres of undeveloped land into a fully functional family farm!

programme.title: The Incredible Pol Farm
programme.desc: After getting the tractor stuck in mud, Charles and Ben need a quick solution to plant hayseed in their field to provide food for their incoming animals. The Pol family must quickly figure out why their field is so wet even though it hasnt rained in days. Meanwhile, Dr. Pol helps Charles and Beth set up their first beehive colonies on the new farm.

programme.title: Australia's Land of the Ancients
programme.desc: Australias Land of the Ancients explores the unique and ancient landscape of northeastern Australia, the most biodiverse region on the continent. From Crocodiles lying in wait for fish and hunting feral pigs to caring marsupial mothers of the far north, the film highlights some of the incredible species as they struggle to survive in their harsh environment amid a changing landscape.

programme.title: Animal Fight Club

programme.title: Australia's Wild Woodlands
programme.desc: "Australia's Wild Woodlands" explores the rich biodiversity and resilience of Australia's eucalyptus forests, home to the world's largest variety of parrots and iconic species like the platypus. These woodlands span vast regions and support diverse wildlife, from red kangaroos to freshwater crocodiles. The film showcases the rare behaviors of marsupials and birds, highlighting threats from climate change and land clearing. Ancient ecosystems remain largely unchanged since the dinosaurs, but species like the Gouldian finch face uncertain futures. Through intimate storytelling, the documentary reveals the ecological importance and fragility of these vibrant landscapes.

programme.title: Europe's Wild Marvels
programme.desc: With leopards in its mountains, blue whales off its coasts, and foxes roaming its city centres, Europe is a continent full of wild surprises. From the frozen glaciers of Iceland to the lush islands of the Azores, and from the rugged peaks of the Caucasus to the metropolis of London, the first episode in this stunning series highlights Europe's astonishing diversity, all shot with breath-taking brio and the latest technology to reveal the continent and its animals in all its breath-taking glory.

programme.title: The Incredible Pol Farm
programme.desc: It's summer in Michigan, which means time to bale some hay! It's a grueling process, but Dr. Pol, Charles, and Ben manage to mow their hayfield, which is the first step in baling. But a surprise rainstorm could ruin this year's hay haul. They hope for sun, so their crop doesn't spoil before they can bale. Meanwhile, the Pol's bring in their next animal to the farm - an emu!

programme.title: The Incredible Pol Farm
programme.desc: It's the county fair season! The Pol's plan to get at least two cows and six sheep at the auction, but they have a lot to do before that can happen. First up, they must install a new perimeter fence. Charles and Ben think they are off to a good start, but when Dr. Pol points out how sneaky sheep can be, their workload doubles. Meanwhile, Beth is hoping for a goat at the small animal auction.

programme.title: Secrets of the Penguins
programme.desc: The emperors are the largest and strongest of all penguins, living in the coldest, most extreme place on Earth. National Geographic Explorer Bertie Gregory embeds with an Antarctic colony and encounters social skills never filmed before. As the planet rapidly warms, he discovers bonds forged from birth between family, friends and strangers are the difference between life and death.

programme.title: South America's Weirdest Animals
programme.desc: South America is a land of extremes. Many hundred thousand square miles of forests, grasslands and mountains. Existing here is a daunting proposition, and some well-known animals have adapted by growing large or very small, each strategy maximizing their chance of survival.

programme.title: Strangest Nature
programme.desc: Evolution has created countless wondrous creatures that are colorful, amazing and strange. The darker side of nature reveals some of the most bizarre forms natural selection has produced. Gaze into the realm of gulpers: animals who waste no time eating their prey — often swallowing it whole. Something deadly lies silent in the leaf litter of West Africa. The Gaboon viper is loaded with the largest fangs and fastest strike of any snake. Further south, the solifuge, or sun spider, darts through the desert, seeking an unlucky bug to mince with its massive mandibles. Strange mouths are also in the ocean. The moray eel is a bizarre fish, but its most characteristic charm is hiding down its dark throat. These and more lie in store.

programme.title: Alaska Animal Rescue: Pint Sized Survivors Compilation
programme.desc: Alaska's conservation heroes are helping orphaned animals with their growing pains. An abandoned young harbor seal takes an epic journey across Alaska to undergo rehabilitation at the Alaska SeaLife Center. The team at the Alaska Wildlife Conservation Center takes on the role of mom for a pair of orphaned moose calves, hoping they survive the crucial first months. They also respond to a call about an unusual squirrelly rescue. And at the Alaska Raptor Center, a trio of tiny, orphaned screech owlets must bulk up before they can be released.

programme.title: Wild Mississippi
programme.desc: North America's most famous waterway, the Mississippi River, is explored in this fantastic documentary series, focussing on the vast numbers of animals that depend on it for survival. With stunning cinematography that highlights its beauty and size, Wild Mississippi reveals the diverse climates and landscapes this enormous waterway covers, with its basin stretching for thousands of miles. A three-part series, each episode focusses on a unique aspect of the river, whether it's the cold, frozen birth as it falls south from the northern states, the floods it causes, both beneficial and detrimental to animals and humans alike, as well as its negative effects, such as the masses of fertiliser it carries into the Gulf of Mexico.

programme.title: Secrets of the Penguins
programme.desc: It takes a special type of courageous penguin to survive the fierce Southern Ocean, but forty million crowd its isolated, rocky outposts. They are the most successful penguins on Earth. National Geographic Explorer Bertie Gregory follows the rockhoppers, gentoos and macaronis to discover a world of risk-takers, rebels, and unconventional parents.

programme.title: Secrets of the Penguins
programme.desc: Millions of years ago, a group of penguins left the ice in search of more. Riding powerful currents, the tiny adventurers arrived in strange new lands, reshaping traditions for deserts, tropics … and even among humans. They were tested to the extreme, becoming perhaps the smartest of them all. National Geographic Explorer Bertie Gregory discovers penguin problem solving, 'talking', and their enduring search for new worlds.

programme.title: Critter Fixers: Country Vets: Compilations
programme.desc: Baby chicks keep Drs. Hodges and Ferguson on their toes! A pregnant husky and a pregnant Doberman pinscher come in, both needing emergency C-sections. A zoo needs help determining the sexes of some beavers under their care. A puppy named Titan is diagnosed with parvo and desperately needs a blood transfusion - Dr. Hodges' dog Bane comes to the rescue! A kitten comes in after being accidentally stepped on by its owner.

programme.title: Critter Fixers: Country Vets: Compilations
programme.desc: House Calls. Dr. Ferguson travels to a local zoo to examine some groundhogs. A mini horse has a mysterious knot on its shoulder. A newborn calf and its mother, suffering a swollen udder, drive the docs to become foster moms for the calf.

programme.title: Critter Fixers: Country Vets: Compilations
programme.desc: The docs at Critter Fixer lend a helping paw to a variety of canine clients. Fifteen small-town celebrity chihuahuas need updated shots after one of their own becomes ill, an adorable puppy steals hearts around the clinic, and another young dog has an unusually large growth. Dr. Hodges helps an Alaskan malamute get its travel papers and attempts to bring a Pomeranian back from the brink. The docs leap into action, trying to save a canine bit by a venomous snake, and perform an emergency C-section to deliver five bulldog puppies.

programme.title: The Casagrandes
programme.desc: Family-orientated cartoon for kids. Ronnie Anne Santiago, her big brother Bobby and their mum have recently moved to Great Lakes City and are now getting used to life in this busy, and sometimes chaotic, new town. Here in the big city they meet the Casagrandes – their extended family made up of grandparents, aunt, uncle, cousins and their pets. Along with a bunch of friends they all live as one big happy family. Skateboarding Ronnie Anne also starts to explore what their new hometown has to offer. Meanwhile, Bobby helps his grandfather Hector working in the family store where they meet lots of interesting characters from the neighbourhood.

programme.title: The Loud House
programme.desc: In this crowded and chaotic household, Lincoln Loud is the only boy among his ten sisters. With eleven children under one roof, things get a little bit crazy sometimes, to say the least. This children's cartoon is fun and light-hearted, and Clyde, Lincoln's best friend, only adds to that. Clyde is an only child by contrast, and is jealous of Lincoln's abundance of siblings. Clyde also has a massive crush on Lori, who is Lincoln's oldest sister. However, she has a boyfriend, Bobby. Bobby, although not being particularly intelligent, has several different jobs, ranging from life guard, to security at a shopping centre.

programme.title: The Fairly OddParents
programme.desc: The Fairly OddParents tells us a story of Timmy Turner, a 10-year-old boy in the fictional town of Dimmsdale. Vicky is his babysitter with vicious temper. His parents are completely indifferent to him. His life is very sad and hopeless until his fairy godparents Wanda and Cosmo apperar in the fishbowl and try to fulfill his every wish. Timmy's greenness in making his wishes causes troubles and he has to "unwish" them together with his fairy godparents to avoid possible disasters. Enjoy Timmy's fantastic adventures in the world of fairies, dragons, unicorns and dwarfs.

programme.title: SpongeBob SquarePants
programme.desc: Deep down in the Pacific Ocean in the subterranean city of Bikini Bottom lives a square yellow sponge named SpongeBob SquarePants. SpongeBob lives in a pineapple with his pet snail, Gary, loves his job as a fry cook at the Krusty Krab, and has a knack for getting into all kinds of trouble without really trying. When he's not getting on the nerves of his cranky next door neighbor Squidward, SpongeBob can usually be found smack in the middle of all sorts of strange situations with his best buddy, the simple yet lovable starfish, Patrick, or his thrill-seeking surfer-girl squirrel pal, Sandy Cheeks.

programme.title: SpongeBob SquarePants
programme.desc: House Fancy: Squidward is enraged when he sees the home of his rival, Squilliam featured on a TV show about fancy houses. Determined not to be outdone, Squidward arranges to have his own house on the program. But he quickly realizes that his house isn't exactly camera-ready and he's going to need a lot of help, even if it means letting SpongeBob redecorate. Plankton's plan: get SpongeBob to write a song about the secret Krabby Patty formula!

programme.title: Tales of the Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles
programme.desc: Raph is freaking out! He wanted to fight everyone, but now he's up against his brothers, and it's the worst. Kitsune and her gang the Purple Dragons captured Mikey, Donnie, and Leo and used mind control devices to send them into the Mutant Battle Arena. They chase Raph through the arena and out to the street where he uses the Turtle Tank as a getaway car. Raph realizes he's in too deep and must turn to an unlikely source for help - the snobby Pigeon Pete! Together, they form a multi-step plan in which Pete will steal the mind control devices right from under the Purple Dragons' noses while Raph distracts all the Mutants in the arena. But things don't go quite as planned and it's up to Raph to save everyone he loves! Can he find a way to disarm the mind control devices and save everyone before it's too late?

programme.title: Tales of the Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles
programme.desc: Ray Fillet is attacked in Central Park by a mutant turtle! Donnie's busy with his robotics project: turning Metalhead into a spider-bot. Wingnut bursts in and tells the Turtles to come quick- Ray is hurt! A woozy Ray blames the Ninja Turtles, and the Mutanimals start a fight with the confused brothers. But when Ray's REAL attacker appears, a mutant snapping turtle named TOKKA, he fights everyone... until his watch starts beeping and he escapes. The Turtles tail him, ending up on the Staten Island ferry. After a big fight, Tokka's trapped. But while questioning him, Tokka explodes into OOZE, leaving only a baby turtle and his watch. Donnie's brothers ask him to hack it and find clues about Tokka, which he says is impossible! Later, Donnie gets a location pin from Wingnut and follows it to an abandoned factory on Staten Island. He finds her and ANOTHER TOKKA that he cleverly takes out! Donnie thinks they're safe until MORE Monster Mutanimals emerge! Could Donnie's day get any worse?

programme.desc: Best Foes: Kowalski invents an enemy detector. As is often the case, it doesn't work, and Skipper gets his own wires crossed when he smashes it. King Julien gets into the act by becoming Skipper's friend too, going so far as to Congaga dance together. New BFF Hans is not happy with the new bromance, however. Could this be the opening the penguins need? Night of the Vesuviuses: The annual Zoo Snooze is here! Kids get to buy tickets for a zoo sleepover, a treat the animals look forward to every year! This year's going to be very different, however, when the rotten Vesuvius Twins buy up all the tickets themselves. The zoosters plan to turn the tables, though, and exact sweet revenge on the twins. The penguins, influenced by Private of course, can't let this happen, and it's a long night's journey into day as the penguins scramble to protect their one-time tormentors.

programme.title: The Penguins of Madagascar
programme.desc: The Penguins of Madagascar is an American animated television series, a spin-off of the Madagascar films. They pretend to be white and fluffy but in reality are fearless adrenaline addicts and a secret spy team on a mission to protect their home in the Central Park Zoo. The penguins often have to deal with problems caused by their zoo lemur neighbors- King Julien XIII, Maurice and Mort. programme.title: The Fairly OddParents: A New Wish

Hazel must get through the dance before Kennueth's true form, and magic, are revealed. // Hazel learns about the harmful effects of trash and pollution on Earth, so she wishes that people wouldn't be such trash monsters. Then, Dale Dimmadome tricks Danky into helping him sell more products, making people even bigger trash monsters! Hazel must get Danky back and stop Dale Dimmadome in his wasteful tracks.

programme.title: The Fairly OddParents: A New Wish
programme.desc: It's Kindness Day! Mr. Guzman announces that if all students complete one act of kindness, they'll get a class pizza party-and Hazel wants that pizza! But when Dev refuses to participate, Cosmo and Wanda call on the Pe-Az, a trio of alien diplomats, to reason with him. Despite their best efforts, Dev outsmarts the Pe-Az and uses their alien technology to get rid of all the pizza on Earth. // Hazel must take matters into her own hands to get to the bottom of Dev's surly attitude and save pizza! When Hazel makes a wish to understand why Dev acts the way he does, she gets paired with him for a class scavenger hunt. They struggle to work together, but, as the day goes on, they develop a friendship. However, that falls apart when Dev's dad, Dale, belittles their effort, causing Dev to turn on Hazel again to save face. Will Dev be able to overcome his pride and finish the project, or will his issues with his dad tank both their grades?

programme.title: The Fairly OddParents: A New Wish

programme.desc: Sette Oscar e un Golden Globe al film di fantascienza di Alfonso Cuaron, con Sandra Bullock e George Clooney. La dottoressa Ryan Stone e' alla sua prima missione spaziale, l'astronauta Matt Kowalsky e' alla guida dello shuttle per l''ultima volta, prima di ritirarsi in pensione. Un viaggio tranquillo che si trasforma presto in una catastrofe quando un esplosione distrugge la navicella causando la morte di tutti gli altri membri dell'equipaggio. I due astronauti vengono proiettati nello spazio profondo, senza alcun contatto con la Terra, apparentemente senza possibilita' di salvarsi.

programme.title: Il Maestro

programme.title: Full Metal Jacket (Edizione Deluxe)

Al campo di addestramento di Parris Island il severissimo sergente di ferro Hartman addestra diciassette reclute a diventare spietati marines: i suoi metodi, durissimi e mortificanti, sono in grado di trasformare i soldati in vere e proprie macchine da guerra, pronte per affrontare l'orrore del conflitto in Vietnam. Come il soldato Joker e il soldato Cowboy che si ritroveranno al fronte, nel cuore del paese di Ho Chi Minh, nel mirino di un misterioso cecchino viet cong.

programme.title: Sully

programme.desc: Marco Bellocchio dirige Pierfrancesco Favino nella biografia del 'boss dei due mondi', Tommaso Buscetta, il primo pentito della mafia, che testimonio' nel maxiprocesso contro Cosa Nostra.

programme.title: Quasi amici
programme.desc: Omar Sy e François Cluzet nella commedia campione d'incassi. Un miliardario paralizzato stringe una grande amicizia con il suo badante: un ragazzo senegalese appena uscito dal carcere.

Il compianto attore partenopeo interpreta Mario, un umile postino che instaura un intenso rapporto d'amicizia con il poeta cileno Pablo Neruda, in esilio su un'isola nel Golfo di Napoli. Nei frequenti colloqui con l'artista Mario impara la magia della poesia, mentre una bellissima ragazza del luogo entra nella sua vita. Nel frattempo, la conclusione del confino separera' i due amici lasciando al destino la possibilita' di rivedersi di nuovo. Oscar alle musiche di Luis Bacalov.

programme.title: Me contro Te: Il film - Vacanze in Transilvania
programme.desc: Sofi', Lui' e i loro amici volano in Transilvania per impedire a Viperiana e alla banda di Malefici di impossessarsi di un potente diamante custodito nel castello del piu' temuto dei vampiri: il Conte Dracula.

programme.title: Moon il panda
programme.desc: Gilles de Maistre firma un inno alla bellezza della natura e all'amicizia tra uomo e animale. Cina: lo svogliato dodicenne Tian, sempre distratto dai videogame, viene mandato dalla nonna sulle montagne del Sichuan dove stringe un legame profondo con un cucciolo di panda.

programme.title: I viaggiatori
programme.desc: Avventuroso viaggio nel tempo targato Sky Original. Un gruppo di adolescenti alla ricerca di un fratello scomparso, viene catapultato nella Roma del 1939 sull'orlo del conflitto mondiale.

programme.title: Biancaneve e il cacciatore
programme.desc: Kristen Stewart, Chris Hemsworth e Charlize Theron nella rilettura della famosa fiaba. La crudele regina incarica un cacciatore di uccidere la figliastra Biancaneve, in fuga verso il bosco.

programme.title: Willy Wonka e la fabbrica di cioccolato
programme.desc: Gene Wilder in un inno alla fantasia, dal romanzo di Roald Dahl. Lo stravagante Willy Wonka accompagna cinque bambini in un tour all'interno della sua inaccessibile fabbrica di dolciumi.

programme.title: Shrek
programme.desc: Oscar 2002 all'animazione che ha rivoluzionato il mondo delle favole. Un orco verde, scorbutico ma dal cuore buono, deve liberare una principessa che nasconde un segreto.

programme.title: Shrek 2
programme.desc: Il divertimento continua in compagnia dell'orco piu' simpatico del grande schermo. Shrek e Fiona dovranno affrontare i genitori di lei, poco propensi ad accettare un "mostro" come genero.

programme.title: Shrek e vissero felici e contenti
programme.desc: Quarto capitolo della saga d'animazione con l'orco piu' famoso di Hollywood. Diventato padre, Shrek sente la nostalgia dei vecchi tempi e cade nella trappola del malefico Tremotino.

programme.title: Trash
programme.desc: Tenera avventura animata, opera prima di Francesco Dafano e Luca Della Grotta. Slim, una scatola logora, e la bottiglia ammaccata Bubbles accompagnano il piccolo Spark, una batteria usata, alla ricerca della Piramide magica: il luogo dove tutti i rifiuti possono avere una seconda chance.

programme.title: Willy Wonka e la fabbrica di cioccolato
programme.desc: Gene Wilder in un inno alla fantasia, dal romanzo di Roald Dahl. Lo stravagante Willy Wonka accompagna cinque bambini in un tour all'interno della sua inaccessibile fabbrica di dolciumi.

programme.title: Indiana Jones - Speciale - Ep. 304 - Indiana Jones - Speciale
programme.desc: Uno speciale per raccontare le avventure del dottor Jones, l'archeologo piu' famoso del mondo interpretato da Harrison Ford e diretto da Steven Spielberg, dall'1 al 7 maggio su Sky Cinema Collection.

programme.title: Moon il panda
programme.desc: Gilles de Maistre firma un inno alla bellezza della natura e all'amicizia tra uomo e animale. Cina: lo svogliato dodicenne Tian, sempre distratto dai videogame, viene mandato dalla nonna sulle montagne del Sichuan dove stringe un legame profondo con un cucciolo di panda.

programme.title: I viaggiatori
programme.desc: Avventuroso viaggio nel tempo targato Sky Original. Un gruppo di adolescenti alla ricerca di un fratello scomparso, viene catapultato nella Roma del 1939 sull'orlo del conflitto mondiale.

programme.title: Sonic 3 - Il film
programme.desc: Jim Carrey e James Marsden nel terzo capitolo dell'avvincente saga che fonde animazione e live action. Shadow, un nuovo nemico dai poteri smisurati, fa il suo ingresso in scena, costringendo Sonic, Knuckles e Tails a stringere un'alleanza con l'odiato Robotnik per salvare la Terra.

programme.title: Il prodigioso Maurice
programme.desc: Animazione Sky Original dal romanzo di Terry Pratchett. L'astuto gatto Maurice coinvolge nel suo piano truffaldino una banda di topi parlanti e il giovane pifferaio Keith.

programme.title: 10 giorni con Babbo Natale
programme.desc: Alessandro Genovesi dirige una commedia natalizia 'on the road' con Fabio De Luigi, Diego Abantantuono e Valentina Lodovini, premiata con il Nastro d'Argento. In camper verso Stoccolma, la famiglia Rovelli investe un uomo che è convinto di essere Babbo Natale.

programme.title: Capitan Sciabola e il diamante magico
programme.desc: Avventura animata nel mondo dei pirati. A caccia di un diamante fatato, Capitan Sciabola incontrerà uno scaltro orfanello, un giovane corsaro e un'avventurosa e intraprendente fanciulla.

programme.title: I Puffi - Il film
programme.desc: Travolgente avventura d'animazione insieme alle piccole e amatissime creature blu nate dalla matita del fumettista Peyo, con le voci di Paolo Bonolis e Luca Laurenti.

programme.title: Rango
programme.desc: Oscar 2012 al miglior film d'animazione. Un bizzarro camaleonte giunge in una cittadina del selvaggio West oppressa dalla siccità e da una spietata banda di fuorilegge senza scrupoli.

programme.title: Ghosthunters - Gli acchiappafantasmi
programme.desc: A caccia di spettri in una commedia fantastica. Tom fa amicizia con il fantasmino Hugo e chiede aiuto a un'investigatrice dell'occulto per aiutarlo a tornare a casa.

programme.title: 10 giorni senza mamma
programme.desc: Fabio De Luigi e Valentina Lodovini nella commedia campione d'incassi di Alessandro Genovesi. Giulia si concede una vacanza a Cuba lasciando il marito ad occuparsi dei figli.

programme.title: I Goonies
programme.desc: Richard Donner firma una memorabile avventura ideata e prodotta da Steven Spielberg. Un gruppo di ragazzi trova una mappa che conduce al leggendario tesoro di un pirata.

programme.title: Dora e la città perduta
programme.desc: Fiaba con Isabela Moner, live-action della serie Nickelodeon. La giovane Dora parte con il cugino e la fedele scimmia per ritrovare i genitori nella leggendaria citta' Inca di Parapata.

programme.title: 10 giorni con Babbo Natale
programme.desc: Alessandro Genovesi dirige una commedia natalizia 'on the road' con Fabio De Luigi, Diego Abantantuono e Valentina Lodovini, premiata con il Nastro d'Argento. In camper verso Stoccolma, la famiglia Rovelli investe un uomo che è convinto di essere Babbo Natale.

programme.title: L'ultimo dominatore dell'aria
programme.desc: Dal regista de "Il sesto senso" un'avventura imperdibile per gli amanti del fantasy. Un bambino di 10 anni scopre di essere l'incarnazione di una divinità, dotato di poteri straordinari e con una missione da predestinato: fermare la sanguinosa guerra che oppone da un secolo la Nazione del Fuoco ai regni di Acqua, Aria e Terra. Adattamento della serie a cartoni "Avatar - la leggenda di Aang", doveva essere il primo film di una trilogia, poi mai realizzata. Formidabile la fotografia di Andrew Lesnie, premio Oscar per "Il signore degli anelli - La compagnia dell'anello".

programme.title: Jumanji
programme.desc: Avventure fantasy per Robin Williams. Due ragazzi rimangono intrappolati nei pericolosi labirinti di un gioco da tavolo e affrontano ogni tipo di insidia per liberarsi.

programme.title: La vigilia di Natale nel Paese delle Meraviglie
programme.desc: La magia del Natale incontra il mondo di "Alice nel paese delle meraviglie" in un'animazione musicale targata Sky Original.

programme.title: Ghosthunters - Gli acchiappafantasmi
programme.desc: A caccia di spettri in una commedia fantastica. Tom fa amicizia con il fantasmino Hugo e chiede aiuto a un'investigatrice dell'occulto per aiutarlo a tornare a casa.

programme.title: Questo o quello - Speciale
programme.desc: Francesco Castelnuovo e Gianni Canova ci portano alla scoperta della mitica trilogia di Robert Zemeckis, disponibile da sabato 12 a lunedi' 14 ottobre su Sky Cinema Collection.

programme.title: 10 giorni senza mamma
programme.desc: Fabio De Luigi e Valentina Lodovini nella commedia campione d'incassi di Alessandro Genovesi. Giulia si concede una vacanza a Cuba lasciando il marito ad occuparsi dei figli.

programme.title: The Portable Door
programme.desc: Dai libri fantasy di Tom Hol, film Sky Original con Christoph Waltz, Sam Neill e Patrick Gibson. Londra: due tirocinanti scoprono che i loro capi vogliono sabotare il mondo della magia.

programme.title: I Goonies
programme.desc: Richard Donner firma una memorabile avventura ideata e prodotta da Steven Spielberg. Un gruppo di ragazzi trova una mappa che conduce al leggendario tesoro di un pirata.

programme.title: Dolittle
programme.desc: Robert Downey Jr. e Antonio Banderas in un’epica avventura ispirata al personaggio dei romanzi firmati da Hugh Lofting. Inghilterra vittoriana: un medico in grado di parlare con gli animali salpa verso un’isola leggendaria alla ricerca di una cura per guarire la regina.

programme.title: L'ultimo dominatore dell'aria
programme.desc: Dal regista de "Il sesto senso" un'avventura imperdibile per gli amanti del fantasy. Un bambino di 10 anni scopre di essere l'incarnazione di una divinità, dotato di poteri straordinari e con una missione da predestinato: fermare la sanguinosa guerra che oppone da un secolo la Nazione del Fuoco ai regni di Acqua, Aria e Terra. Formidabile la fotografia di Andrew Lesnie, premio Oscar per "Il signore degli anelli - La compagnia dell'anello".

programme.title: Trolls
programme.desc: Dai creatori di "Shrek", un film d'animazione con le allegre creature dal ciuffo ribelle. La principessa Poppy e il malinconico Branch devono salvare i Trolls dai loro mortali nemici.

programme.title: The Americas
programme.desc: La catena montuosa più lunga della Terra. Qui le foreste nebulose ospitano orsi e colibrì, i vulcani eruttano accanto a cime ricoperte da ghiacciai e aridi deserti.

programme.title: I Caraibi

programme.desc: Nel delta del Mississippi per un vampire movie con Michael B. Jordan e Hailee Steinfeld. 1932: due gemelli afroamericani dal passato travagliato tornano nella città natale per aprire un night club per la comunità nera locale, ma devono affrontare un nemico terrificante.

programme.title: Il potere dei soldi
programme.desc: Robert Luketic dirige con maestria Gary Oldman e Harrison Ford in uno spy-thriller sullo spietato mondo dell'alta finanza a Wall Street. Dopo aver commesso un imperdonabile errore, un giovane e ambizioso impiegato di una multinazionale ha la possibilita' di riabilitarsi agli occhi del suo capo e salvare il posto. Ma il boss in realta' lo ricatta, costringendolo a farsi assumere dalla societa' concorrente per rubare il prototipo di un nuovo prodotto. Dalla padella nella brace, si accorgera' di essere la semplice pedina di uno sporco gioco.

programme.title: Le Notti Di Salem
programme.desc: Tornato alla sua città natale nella speranza di riprendere a scrivere, Ben Mears scopre che è dominata dai vampiri e che l'unico modo per liberarla è entrare a far parte di una banda che sta tentando di sconfiggere queste creature.

programme.desc: I Manetti Bros. dirigono Giacomo Gianniotti, Miriam Leone, Valerio Mastandrea e Monica Bellucci nel secondo film sul fumetto cult. Diabolik ed Eva Kant cadono nel piano di Ginko.

In questo scenario da incubo, Nico, immune al virus, è pronto a infrangere la legge per liberare la sua fidanzata dall'isolamento.

Viviana convince quindi Modesto a rivolgersi a un analista, star di una trasmissione televisiva, per cercare un futuro nel loro rapporto. Ma Viviana e Modesto non sono una coppia, almeno ufficialmente. Tratto dall’omonimo romanzo di Diego De Silva, autore della sceneggiatura con il regista Alessio Maria Federici.

Egoista e bugiardo, finge di essere disabile per conquistare la bella Marie. La messa in scena del playboy si complica pero' quando la donna gli presenta sua sorella Florence, la quale e' costretta veramente a vivere su una sedia a rotelle. Jocelyn dovra' fare i conti con un aspetto da lui sempre trascurato, il sentimento, quello che inizia a provare per Florence. Diretto dallo stesso Franck Dubosc, al suo esordio dietro la macchina da presa.

Andrea e' un affermato neurochirurgo, sua moglie Sofia una conduttrice televisiva: sono sposati, hanno due figli ma il loro rapporto attraversa una crisi nera. Non riescono proprio a capire le reciproche difficolta', almeno fino a quando non ci mette lo zampino il destino: un esperimento scientifico riuscito male scaraventa l'uno nel corpo dell'altra innescando una serie di momenti imbarazzanti ma molto divertenti. Andrea e Sofia scopriranno nella pratica cosa significa vivere nei panni del partner.

programme.title: Nfl: Seattle – La Rams
programme.desc: Nakon uvjerljive pobjede 41:6 nad San Francisco 49ersima u Divisional Roundu, Seahawksi iz Washingtona po prvi put od sezone 2014. igraju NFC Championship.

programme.title: Nogomet – Liga Prvaka: Bayern – Real Madrid
programme.desc: FC Bayern München i Real Madrid pobrinuli su se za spektakl na Bernabéu u kojem su Bavarci slavili 2:1, a drugi susret četvrtfinala Lige prvaka na rasporedu je 15. travnja u 21:00 u kojem se...

programme.title: Košarka – Aba Liga: Bosna – Dubai
programme.desc: U prvom kolu Top 8 ABA lige trenutno najbolji na tablici, BC Dubai svladao je KK Bosnu rezultatom 100:82. Bosna se sada na parketu Mirza Delibašić dvorane u utakmici osmog kola nada drugačijem...

programme.title: Rukomet – Lp (ž): Esbjerg – Csm Bucurest

programme.title: Nogomet – Francuska Liga: Lens – Toulouse

programme.title: Nogomet – Premier League: Manchester City – Arsenal
programme.desc: Manchester City i Arsenal odmjerit će snage u 33. kolu Premier League 19. travnja 2026. u 17:30 na Etihad Stadionu.

programme.title: Nogomet – Talijanska Liga: Roma – Atalanta
programme.desc: U posljednjih sedam utakmica protiv Rome Atalanta nije izgubila nijednu, a pobijedila je čak šest puta, niz se nada nastaviti i u 33. kolu Serie A, a oba kluba love priliku za Europu.

programme.title: Ligue 1 Show
programme.desc: Pratite prestižnu francusku nogometnu ligu i gledajte fantastične klubove koji se bore za bitnu titulu. Liga postoji još od 1932. godine i okuplja neke od najboljih nogometaša iz cijeloga svijeta.

programme.title: Nogomet – Ruska Premier Liga: Orenburg – Pari Nn
programme.desc: Orenburg i Pari Nizhny Novgorod love priliku za ostanak u ligi, a nova tri boda traže u međusobnoj utakmici u 26. kolu Ruske Premier lige.

programme.title: Mi Živimo Za Košarku
